item.title: Green Lane controversial yellow box should be reviewed and potentially changed due to the serious issues. Greenwich Council should review the junction layout with respect to data about usage, congestion, road safety and traffic impact. Greenwich Council planners need to recognise the real world effects of their designs, which can only be understood through a full post implementation review. There is a need to assess the wider impacts on traffic flow, accessibility and amend, redesign or remove elements of the scheme for significant safety or operational concerns identified. by the community to generally restore more efficient, safe and predictable traffic movement at the Green Lane junction with William Barefoot Drive., 23rd August
